calls.title: Features Standup
calls.summary: Key priorities discussed included adding per-environment values for feature flags and experiments, allowing updates through API calls, which would reduce reliance on UI access. Ryan highlighted the complexity of AI integration, necessitating careful schema design and type safety to avoid errors. The team emphasized the importance of tool registration, where each tool provides a defined input schema to guide AI behavior and error handling. A debugging tool was introduced to facilitate manual testing and ensure quality before AI integration. Future plans include demonstrations to enhance team familiarity with the tools and a focus on clear documentation for onboarding.
calls.keywords: feature flags, MCP server, SDK tools, Large Language Models, API schema, debugging tool
